name: Xero MCP Server
summary: Xero's official local MCP server for its accounting API: contacts, invoices, chart of accounts, payroll and reports.
description: Runs with `npx -y @xeroapi/xero-mcp-server@latest` (Node 18+). Authenticate with a Xero Custom Connection (client ID and secret for one organisation) or a bearer token (XERO_CLIENT_BEARER_TOKEN takes precedence). Registers 51 tools (list/get/create/update/delete across contacts, invoices, quotes, credit notes, payments, bank transactions, manual journals, tracking categories, reports and payroll). There is no read-only flag or tool filter: every tool is always registered, and what actually works depends on the scopes requested via XERO_SCOPES and those granted to the connection. Custom connections created from Apr 29, 2026 need the newer granular scopes; the server falls back automatically. Payroll tools need an NZ or UK organisation. Some README tool names differ from the registered ones: the payroll timesheet tools are registered as e.g. delete-timesheet, create-timesheet and add-timesheet-line (README: delete-payroll-timesheet, …), and create-tracking-options (README: create-tracking-option). npm `@xeroapi/xero-mcp-server` is 0.0.17 (2026-05-26) while the repo's package.json still says 0.0.16. For a hosted server see xero-remote-mcp. MIT.

agent_access.notes: Xero Custom Connection (XERO_CLIENT_ID/XERO_CLIENT_SECRET) or XERO_CLIENT_BEARER_TOKEN. A Xero account is needed (a free trial works).
